gc_confound.consequence: In free mode edit distance and GC content cannot be separated; any effect attributed to one could be the other. Neutral mode removes the confound by construction and costs space.
gc_confound.which_is_primary: not decided; both are recorded so the choice rests on these numbers
gc_confound.why: The reference 5' window is GC-maximal for this protein segment, so every synonymous edit moves GC down or sideways. The correlation is a property of editing away from a GC-optimised reference, not a sampler artifact, and sampling cannot remove it in free mode.

no_claim: Specifying a design space establishes no stability, translation or expression benefit.
No member was scored, ranked or proposed for an assay.
The 30-codon window and the 5' region are declared choices, not findings of this project.
A free-mode pool cannot separate edit distance from GC content.
Protein preservation is verified; nothing else about a member is verified.
purpose: The windowed synonymous design space, enumerated into finite pools. A specification of the optimisation domain, not a candidate set.
